label: prop:qbeta-c-k-closed-forms
title: Closed-form conjectures for $c_4, c_5, c_6, c_7$ in the $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ precision ladder: empirical pattern-matches to sub-percent residual; first-principles derivation open (Khovanov-Rozansky at finite $q$ or KLR canonical-basis trace)
html:
Closed-form conjectures for the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder coefficients c_4, c_5, c_6, c_7.

We formalize these coefficients as conjectures. This permits downstream claims to use the conditional-class exception, as implemented in prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder via the Lean class QBetaPrecisionLadderCoefficients. In terms of the Hopf–Jones seed c_3 = -2 and the Kashiwara coupling b, the conjectured closed forms are

  c_4 = c_3\, b^4 = -2 b^4, \qquad
  c_5 = -\bigl(b^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}\bigr), \qquad
  c_6 = c_3^2\, b^2 = 4 b^2, \qquad
  c_7 = c_3^3 = -8,

with empirical match quality tabulated below.

Closed forms

Rung Conjectured closed form Empirical match Categorical interpretation
c_4 c_3 \cdot b^4 = -2 \cdot b^4 0.9% residual Hopf Jones \times Kashiwara b^4 correction (multiplicative mixing)
c_5 -(b^2 + 1/2) 2.4% residual Kashiwara b^2 + half-Hopf integer offset (mixed)
c_6 c_3^2 \cdot b^2 = 4 \cdot b^2 14% residual Hopf Jones squared \times Kashiwara b^2
c_7 c_3^3 = -8 signed error +114\% Hopf Jones cubed

Match quality degrades at higher k. For c_7, the signed relative error is approximately 114\% (magnitude error 86\%). We retain the conjecture because the N=7 correction's leverage on the cumulative \mathfrak{Q}_\beta residual operates at the 10^{-13} scale. Any c_7 \in [-100, +100] closes the gap to within 10^{-4} ppb, leaving the numerical value highly under-determined.

Derivation paths

Three formal derivation paths stand open:

  1. Khovanov–Rozansky polynomial at finite q: Compute \mathrm{Kh}(L)(q, t) for the typed-\mathbf{B}_3 Markov-closure link L at the substrate q_0 (not merely q = 1). The Taylor coefficients should return c_4, c_5, c_6, c_7.
  2. KLR canonical-basis trace formula: Calculate the per-Wedderburn-block canonical-basis Markov trace at orders \varepsilon^8, \varepsilon^{10}, \varepsilon^{12}. The Hecke–KLR bridge supplies scaffolding (conj:kazhdan-lusztig-classical-limit). We require the explicit per-block trace formula.
  3. Spectral-sequence stratification: Currently declined; the framework lacks a suitable candidate spectral sequence.

Precision

The +6.02 ppb residual at N=3 recorded for this ladder, and the sub-1 ppb figures the higher rungs (c_4 to c_7) reach, are not a current statement that the 100\times accuracy target for \mathfrak{Q}_\beta is met. Both are properties of a cell the framework has since retired, and they are quoted here as a record of that cell, not as a prediction.

Two scopings apply, and neither was present when those figures were first written:

  1. Convention. The ladder was built with the Markov parameter z_C = \sqrt{q}/(q+1) (convention C), which is excised; the canonical parameter is z_D = q^3/(q^2+1). No convention-D counterpart exists to compare against, so the figure is unreproducible under the canonical convention.
  2. Functional. The published form rests on z = 1, which is inadmissible: it is the coordinate sum, and provably not a Markov root under convention D (ConventionDAdmissibleRoots.lean, sorry-free).

Against the same 7.797 ppb target, the live per-observable dashboard scores \mathfrak{Q}_\beta on the ruled base at 1.668\times10^{8} ppb — a miss of 2.139\times10^{7}, the largest in the table. That figure and the +6.02 ppb above are different objects: the dashboard evaluates the ruled z_D base with zero c_k rungs, while the figure above is the five-rung ladder on the retired z = 1 cell. The comparison is stated so a reader meets both, not to present either as the other's correction.

Under the three-calibration discipline, the higher rungs are calibration-anchored fits: they encode the CODATA datum they are matched to, so they are a calibration record rather than a prediction, and any downstream claim relying on them must declare that dependency.

Evidence

A direct SDP-T_\beta extraction at 50 decimal places was recorded as reproducing the conjectured c_k. The table is a historical record and is reproduced with its provenance, because one entry is superseded and the rest have no live producer.

c_2 extracted = -1.0171   (vs framework -1)
c_3 extracted = -2.0098   ← SUPERSEDED; see below
c_4 extracted = -1.1435   (matches empirical sweep exactly)
c_5 extracted = -1.2229   (matches empirical sweep exactly)
c_6 extracted = +3.4976   (matches empirical sweep exactly)
c_7 extracted = +57.149   (matches empirical sweep exactly)

c_3: the recorded -2.0098 matches no value the corpus now carries. It is a superseded figure, retired when the substrate anchors were re-derived. The live convention-C extractions are

anchor c_3
proton (the canonical compute pin) -2.06934257711516783787971951725
muon, CODATA 2022 -2.019860311874005
muon, CODATA 2018 -2.020200233

Since this block states no anchor, the proton value is the one to read here: it is the pin all production compute defaults to. All three are convention C; under convention D the same extraction gives -974.43, which is the scoping the previous section describes.

The other five entries are recorded, not verified. No producer in computations/ publishes -1.1435, -1.2229, +3.4976 or +57.149 today — the canonical qbeta-ck-cache witness stops after one rung by design, because extracting a rung by inverting the target drives the next residual to exactly zero. They are retained as the calibration record they were, and should not be cited as current extractions.

The empirical c_k from binding_q_target_sweep are fits: each is extracted by matching the truncated product to the measured CODATA \mathfrak{Q}_\beta value, so it encodes the datum it is matched against. That is a calibration tautology, not a derivation, and it is why the rungs carry no predictive content. What the conjectures above propose is a categorical interpretation of those extracted constants — a closed form that would make them derived rather than matched. Until such a form is exhibited, the ladder is a calibration record.
